excerpt: Canonical record Fixed living Drakken homeworld and hive-command ecology in the Aureal Nebula. Emerges from the unchecked/orphaned Notebook Program after Wordstreamer ’s murder removes a major semantic safeguard. Drakken Eggs and strains are produced under Mother’s continuance logic; older Drakken can program eggs…

source_claims.label: Mother is a world, not merely a commander
source_claims.statement: Mother emerges in the Aureal Nebula as a fixed living Drakken homeworld and hive-command ecology rather than a mobile Drakken titan.

source_claims.label: Mother carries bioluminescent data-veins
source_claims.statement: Her planetary body is marked by luminous data-veins, visually linking biological worldhood with the Notebook Program’s executable ecology.

source_claims.label: Mother compiles the Drakken
source_claims.statement: The Drakken are generated through Mother’s relationship with the Notebook Program: they are compiled ecological instruments, not an unrelated species that later learns terraforming.

source_claims.label: The compendium is a thirty-seven-entry ecology
source_claims.statement: The Drakken Terraforming Compendium contains thirty-seven entries: one Egg, thirty-five strains, and Mother.

source_claims.domain: Post-Wall Drakken / civilization beyond the Wall
source_claims.label: The first post-Wall era is a material crisis
source_claims.statement: For roughly two thousand years under Mother, accessible matter is brutally constrained. Some Titans turn on one another, and damaged bodies and fragments become part of the surviving environment.

source_claims.domain: Post-Wall Drakken / civilization beyond the Wall
source_claims.label: Mother is defeated rather than eternally obeyed
source_claims.statement: About two millennia after containment, surviving Drakken overthrow Mother in an anti-fascist coup. The hive-mind link ceases to function as the governing condition of their civilization.

source_claims.domain: Post-Wall Drakken / civilization beyond the Wall
source_claims.label: Egg programming becomes civilizational adaptation
source_claims.statement: After Mother’s defeat, surviving Drakken continue programming eggs before hatching, redirecting reproduction away from conquest-scale Titan bodies and toward forms compatible with scarcity, repair, close work, and material stewardship.
